title: Directives and calls
goal: Separate form context, no-context server calculation and client interaction.
prerequisites: onec.p7; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.
sections: AtClient selects client execution; AtServer uses the form’s server context; AtServerNoContext does not automatically receive it. Method names do not select execution location. Compiler and runtime availability follow actual directives and module type.

One complete module demonstrates three boundaries. &НаКлиенте manages messages/dialogs; &НаСервере СверитьБуфер uses form data; &НаСервереБезКонтекста ЧасыНаСервере consumes only its numeric input. Directives express dependencies rather than decoration.

A pure calculation can use a no-context server method with explicit minutes/rate. Reading form attributes there reveals a hidden dependency to remove. Passing the whole form is not parameter design. A no-context call alone does not prove speedup without data-volume measurements.

The no-context function cannot read Объект. Minutes suffice, so avoid passing an entire document. Persisted reading needs a separate keyed function with appropriate rights. Minimal inputs simplify testing and reduce accidental state transfer.

A form-state operation may legitimately need context. Do not move everything toNoContext as a slogan. Separate data acquisition, pure computation andUIupdates. A matrix shows what can be tested without a window and what actually requires form state.

Check Thin client, Server and Thick managed client compilation. This checks name/context availability, not an actual network installation. An ordinary run separately verifies90→1.5 and rejection of1441.

Compare two calculation versions with identical explicit inputs. In an experimental copy, access a form attribute fromNoContext and detect the dependency. Do not hide it in a global variable. Test missing input and repeats so prior form state cannot influence the next result.

In another source copy intentionally read Объект inside the no-context function, retain the diagnostic and restore the argument. Do not fix it with Privileged or by moving all database work to the client; that changes the trust boundary.
